# Hosea Chapter 10 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 332r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/HOS_010_page_001.jpg

---

**10:1** Yisra'el [is] a-luxuriant [boqeq] vine [gefen]; fruit [peri] he-sets [yeshavveh] for-himself; according-to the-abundance [ke-rov] of-his-fruit he-multiplied [hirbah] altars [la-mizbechot]; according-to the-goodness [ke-tov] of-his-land they-made-good [heitivu] pillars [matssevot].

**10:12** Sow [zir'u] for-yourselves in-righteousness [li-tsdaqah]; reap [qitsru] according-to loyalty [le-fi chesed]; break-up [niru] for-yourselves fallow-ground [nir]; for [it is] time [et] to-seek [lidrosh] YHWH, until [ad] he-comes [yavo] and-rains [veyoreh] righteousness [tsedeq] upon-you.

**10:13** You-have-plowed [charashtem] wickedness [resha]; injustice [avllatah] you-have-reaped [qetsartem]; you-have-eaten [akhaltem] the-fruit of-lies [pachash]; for you-have-trusted [batachta] in-your-way [be-darkkekha], in-the-multitude [be-rov] of-your-warriors [gibborekha].

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "luxuriant vine":** The vine metaphor echoes Isaiah 5 — Israel is a productive vine, but all its productivity goes into multiplying altars and sacred pillars for false worship.

**v.12 — "Sow righteousness, reap loyalty":** One of Hosea's most hopeful appeals — agricultural imagery for moral renewal. Break the fallow ground of hardened hearts and plant *tsdaqah* (righteousness). The harvest will be *chesed* (loyalty/love).

*— EMET*
